Reform Jersey is a social-democratic political party, currently with five elected members of the States Assembly.

We (Reform Jersey) believe that the role of the state is to create an environment in which every individual can achieve their potential, regardless of their race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability or social background.

We (Reform Jersey) believe that it is the duty of the state, in partnership with its citizens, to help create a society that works for all, including the poorest and most disadvantaged. We believe in speaking up for the vulnerable, encouraging those with aspiration, and ensuring all can live in a society built on social and economic justice. We wish the Island to prosper in a manner that will improve the wellbeing of all current and future citizens.
